segments.text: Ok so this is the Headless Threads page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the page says the list is server authoritative, but never says which server provides it.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. After chatting, the thread list should show the conversation, but it only shows the new conversation button.
So basically, inject threads should give you the saved conversations.
No threads ever show up, and the page doesn't say what backend serves them.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
